newsitem.title: USA: Roadway backs $1.35-$1.40 FY97 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Roadway backs $1.35-$1.40 FY97 EPS estimate.

text.p: Roadway Express Inc chief financial officer Dawson Cunningham said Thursday the trucking company is comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates for 1997 of $1.35-$1.40 a share versus 1996's $1.07, which was reported earlier Thursday.
First Call's showed a mean estimate for 1997 of $1.49, but Cunningham said one high estimate of $2.10 was factored into that.
"If you were to exclude that it would drop back down into the $1.35-$1.40 range," he said in a telephone interview. "I would say at this point ... we are comfortable with that."
The stock rose 2-1/8 to 23-1/4 on Nasdaq after Roadway's yearend report.
Roadway, which spun off from its parent Caliber System Inc last January, in 1995 posted a net loss of $0.62.
